title: URL heuristics — derived from field data, steel-plated, melded into server
motto: Heuristics from evidence, not vibes. Steel plate it. Meld it in. Know why.

why_meld.summary: Dangerous URLs were scattered across annoyance TSV, honorability, X purge, tco-kill, and operator ledgers. One steel plate fuses them so DNS, gatekeeper, API, and caches read the same gone-truth.

reasons.why: Annoyance scores and honor stars are witnessed complaints — heuristics inherit complaint_score ≥ 8 and stars ≤ 1 as gone.
t.co and syndication.twimg add middleman hops — unwrap_kill or drop_lane from X brand purge data.
Canonical allow list from honorability 5★ + operator lanes — x.com, google, youtube, github stay open.
Unknown shorteners and pipe-to-shell patterns inherit gone until proven allow — steel plate fail-closed.
Plate meld + ironclad extension — server reads meld first; no drift between adblock, url-kill, and gatekeeper.
